message.precast_structure.invalid_platfo: Place the scanner next to a Platform Floor rectangle of at least 3×3.
message.precast_structure.invalid_floor: The connected Platform Floor blocks must form a solid filled rectangle.
message.precast_structure.invalid_fence: Place Perimeter Fence or Fence Gate blocks one block above the platform border (except the scaffold corner).
message.precast_structure.invalid_height: Place a Metal Scaffold pillar on exactly one platform corner to set the structure height.
message.precast_structure.needs_empty_bl: Hold at least one Empty Blueprint to scan.
message.precast_structure.printer_needs_: Insert a Blueprint into the Structure Printer.
message.precast_structure.invalid_bluepr: That blueprint could not be read.
message.precast_structure.missing_materi: You do not have the required building materials.
message.precast_structure.deploy_overlap: Cannot place a structure inside one that is still deploying.
tooltip.precast_structure.blank_blueprin: Used by the Structure Scanner to capture a build
tooltip.precast_structure.ghost_preview: Shows a ghost preview while held
config.precast_structure.title: Pre-cast Structure Config
config.precast_structure.scanning.min_ti: Shortest scan animation length, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.precast_structure.scanning.ticks_: Extra scan duration added for each block of frame height.
config.precast_structure.scanning.sound_: How often the scanning loop sound plays, in ticks.
config.precast_structure.deploy.animated: If disabled, pre-cast structures place instantly with no rising-plane animation.
config.precast_structure.deploy.min_tick: Shortest deploy animation length, in ticks.
config.precast_structure.deploy.ticks_pe: Extra deploy duration added for each block of structure height.
config.precast_structure.deploy.sound_in: How often the deploy loop sound plays, in ticks.
config.precast_structure.deploy.client_g: Client ticks to keep the solid ghost cover after placement while lighting updates.
config.precast_structure.frame.max_platf: Maximum platform width, depth, and scaffold height (inclusive).
config.precast_structure.blueprint.max_d: Hard clamp applied to blueprint size axes when loading saved data.
config.precast_structure.printer.default: Fallback print duration in ticks. Worlds still use the precastStructurePrinterDelay gamerule.
config.precast_structure.hologram.solid_: When enabled, scan and deploy holograms use invisible solid hitboxes so players and entities cannot walk through them.
